name: Misato (Miyazaki, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in blue and green: a blue stylised swoosh with green leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 March 2006.

features.role: Misato town emblem — a blue stylised swoosh with green leaves
